blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Supervised synthetic CT generation is commonly formulated as a voxel-wise regression problem between MRI or CBCT inputs and registered reference CT images. This formulation assumes that paired images are spatially aligned at the voxel level, although in practice multimodal pairs are constructed through registration procedures that inevitably leave residual anatomical misalignments. These residual errors are not independent intensity noise, but spatially coherent geometric discrepancies that can act as structured label noise during training. In this work, we investigate how registration-induced supervision bias affects supervised MRI-to-CT and CBCT-to-CT synthesis. We show that quantitative performance strongly depends on the consistency between the registration strategy used to construct the training targets and the one used during evaluation. Models achieve better voxel-wise scores when both conventions match, indicating that supervised synthesis networks can partially learn the geometric convention imposed by the registration pipeline. This effect also impacts out-of-distribution robustness and predictive uncertainty, with less geometrically consistent supervision leading to larger prediction variability. This work does not aim to solve registration errors through a new synthesis architecture, but to demonstrate that residual registration defines a supervision convention that supervised networks can learn and that standard metrics can reward. We validate this analysis on 1,784 paired patients from six clinical centers, covering MRI-to-CT and CBCT-to-CT synthesis across five anatomical regions. To mitigate the limitations of purely voxel-wise supervision, we introduce a SAM-based perceptual loss that compares synthesized and reference CT images in the feature space of a pretrained Segment Anything encoder. Compared with MAE-only and VGG-based perceptual objectives, this supervision improves downstream anatomical metrics and produces sharper, more structurally coherent synthetic CT images. We further show that perceptual and voxel-wise metrics may disagree when references are imperfectly aligned, while becoming more consistent when the evaluation geometry is reliable. Overall, this study identifies registration-induced bias as a central confounder in supervised synthetic CT generation. Our results argue that
synthetic CT methods should not be evaluated solely through voxel-wise agreement with imperfect reference images, but also through anatomy-oriented criteria that assess whether patient-specific structures are faithfully preserved.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Synthetic CT generation aims to transform MRI or CBCT images into CT-like images that can be used by downstream tools originally designed for CT images, including dose calculation, segmentation, and image registration [ 1 , 2 ] . In recent years, supervised image-to-image translation has become the dominant paradigm for this task, largely driven by public benchmarks and large paired datasets. In this setting, models are trained to minimize voxel-wise reconstruction losses between the synthesized CT and a reference CT, and performance is commonly assessed using intensity-based metrics such as MAE, PSNR, and SSIM.
blocks.zh: 合成CT生成旨在将核磁共振或CBCT图像转化为CT类图像,这些图像可以被最初为CT图像设计的下游工具使用,包括剂量计算,分解,和图像注册[1,2]. 近年来,受监督的图像到图像翻译成为这项任务的主要范例,主要受公共基准和大型对映数据集的驱动。 在此设置中,模型经过培训,可以将合成的CT和参考CT之间的Voxel-wiside重建损失降到最低,性能通常使用基于强度的度量,如MAE,PSNR,和SSIM等进行评估.

blocks.en: This indicator-based approach raises a Goodhart-type concern: when an indicator becomes the target of optimization, it may no longer be a reliable indicator of the underlying objective it was intended to measure [ 3 ] . In synthetic CT image generation, the goal is not simply to reproduce a reference image voxel by voxel, but to produce a CT-like image that preserves the patient-specific anatomy of the source modality. If the reference used for supervision and evaluation is imperfect, optimizing voxel-level scores may therefore prioritize consistency with the reference’s construction process rather than anatomical fidelity.
blocks.zh: 这种基于指标的方法引起了Goodhart类型的关切:当一项指标成为优化的目标时,它可能不再是衡量它打算衡量的基本目标的可靠指标。 在合成CT图像生成中,目标不仅仅是通过Voxel来复制参考图像voxel,而是产生类似CT的图像,以保存来源模式中患者特有的解剖学. 如果用于监督和评价的参考不完善,那么优化阴道等级的分数可能优先与参考的构建过程保持一致,而不是解剖忠诚。

blocks.en: This issue is particularly relevant because the supervised formulation relies on a strong geometric assumption: the input image and the reference CT must be spatially aligned at the voxel level. In practice, MRI-CT and CBCT-CT pairs are acquired at different times, under different acquisition conditions, and often in different anatomical configurations [ 1 , 4 ] . The reference CT used for supervision is therefore not a true voxel-wise ground truth, but a registered target that may contain residual alignment errors. These residuals do not behave as independent intensity noise. They correspond to spatially coherent anatomical displacements and can therefore be interpreted as structured geometric label noise [ 5 , 6 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh: 这个问题尤其相关,因为被监督的配体依赖于一个强几何的假设:输入图像和参考CT必须在voxel级别上空间对齐. 在实践中,MRI-CT和CBCT-CT对是在不同的时间,不同的获取条件下获得的,并且往往在不同的解剖配置中[1,4]. 因此,用于监督的参考CT并不是真实的Voxel-wise的地面真理,而是可能包含剩余对齐错误的注册目标. 这些残留物不具有独立强度噪声的作用. 它们与空间连贯的解剖转移相对应,因此可以解释为结构化的几何标签噪声[5,6,2].

blocks.en: This has important consequences for both training and evaluation. During training, voxel-wise losses encourage the model to reproduce the statistical structure of the registered targets, including residual deformations and systematic biases introduced by the registration pipeline [ 7 , 8 , 9 ] . During evaluation, reference-based metrics may reward agreement with a particular registration convention rather than faithful preservation of the source anatomy [ 10 ] . As a result, a model may achieve strong quantitative scores while partially learning or reproducing misalignment patterns embedded in the supervised data.
blocks.zh: 这对培训和评价都有重要影响。 在培训期间,Voxel损失鼓励该模型复制已登记目标的统计结构,包括剩余变形和登记管道引入的系统性偏差[7、8、9]。 在评价期间,基于参考的衡量标准可能奖励与某一特定登记公约达成的协议,而不是忠实地保存源解剖[10]。 因此,一个模型可能会在部分学习或复制嵌入在被监管数据中的错配模式的同时,实现强量化分数.

blocks.en: In this work, we investigate registration-induced supervision bias in supervised synthetic CT generation. Our primary objective is to determine whether residual registration defines a geometric convention that synthesis networks can learn and that reference-based metrics can subsequently reward. We analyze how the registration method used to construct training and evaluation pairs affects quantitative performance, out-of-distribution (OOD) behavior, and predictive uncertainty [ 11 ] . This analysis tests whether measured performance reflects synthesis fidelity alone or also agreement with the registration pipeline.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们调查受监督的合成CT生成中注册引起的监督偏差。 我们的首要目标是确定剩余登记是否界定了合成网络可以学习的几何常规,以及基于参考的衡量标准可以随后得到奖励。 我们分析用于构建培训和评价对等的登记方法如何影响量化性能、分配外行为和预测性不确定性[11]。 这种分析测试是仅反映合成忠贞性还是也与登记管道达成一致。

blocks.en: To mitigate the limitations of purely voxel-wise supervision, we further introduce a SAM-based perceptual loss for synthetic CT generation. Instead of comparing images only at the intensity level, this loss compares synthesized and reference CT images in the feature space of a pretrained Segment Anything encoder [ 12 ] . It is intended to promote spatially coherent anatomical structures and reduce regression-induced blurring, but it does not eliminate the systematic geometric bias contained in imperfectly registered training targets.
blocks.zh: 为了减轻纯阴性监督的局限性,我们进一步为合成CT生成引入基于SAM的知觉损失. 这种损失不是只在强度水平上比较图像,而是在预先训练的片段任意编码器的特性空间里比较合成和参考的CT图像[12]. 其目的是促进空间连贯的解剖结构,减少回归引起的模糊,但并没有消除不完善注册培训目标中所包含的系统性几何偏差。

blocks.en: Overall, this study argues that synthetic CT generation should not be evaluated solely as an intensity regression problem. When reference images are imperfectly aligned, voxel-wise metrics can become confounded by registration errors and may reward conformity to a registration convention rather than preservation of the source anatomy. SAM-based perceptual supervision is therefore investigated as a partial anatomy-oriented response within the broader analysis of this supervision and evaluation bias.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,本研究认为,合成CT生成不应仅仅作为一个强度回归问题来评价. 当参考图像不完美地对齐时,通过阴道测量法可能会因登记错误而变得混乱,可能奖励符合登记公约,而不是保留源解剖学。 因此,基于SAM的知觉监督在对这种监督和评价偏差的更广泛分析中被调查为部分以解剖学为导向的反应.

blocks.en: Contributions
blocks.zh: 捐款

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are as follows:
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献如下:

blocks.en: • We formulate residual registration errors as structured geometric label noise in voxel-wise supervised synthetic CT generation, distinguishing their variable and systematic effects on the learned target distribution. • We empirically demonstrate that voxel-wise performance depends on the consistency between the registration conventions used to construct training targets and evaluation references, showing that standard metrics can reward agreement with the registration pipeline. • We analyze the consequences of registration-induced supervision bias for source-anatomy preservation, regression-induced blurring, OOD generalization, and predictive uncertainty. • We introduce and evaluate SAM-based perceptual supervision and a separately calibrated SAM-based evaluation metric as complementary anatomy-oriented tools beyond direct voxel-wise agreement.

blocks.en: II Background
blocks.zh: 二. 背景情况

blocks.en: II-A Image-to-Image Translation: Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: II-A 图像到图像翻译:问题表述

blocks.en: Image-to-image translation transforms an image from a source domain into a target-domain representation while preserving the task-relevant content of the input [ 13 , 14 ] . In synthetic CT generation, this corresponds to predicting CT-like images from MRI or CBCT acquisitions for applications such as dose calculation, segmentation, and image registration [ 15 , 16 , 17 , 18 ] . This study focuses on supervised conditional synthesis, in which paired images provide voxel-level targets for model training.
blocks.zh: 图像到图像翻译将一个图像从源域转换成目标域代表,同时保留输入中的任务相关内容[13,14]. 在合成CT生成中,这对应了预测MRI或CBCT获得的类似CT的图像,用于剂量计算,分解,图像注册等应用[15,16,17,18]. 本研究侧重于有监督的有条件合成,其中配对图像为模型培训提供了voxel级目标.

blocks.en: When spatially aligned pairs are available, synthesis models are commonly optimized using direct reconstruction losses such as the mean absolute error (MAE) or mean squared error (MSE).

This effect arises because pointwise objectives collapse the variability of the conditional distribution p ⁡ ( y ∣ x ) p(y\mid x) into a single central-tendency estimate. Under common modeling assumptions, such objectives can also be interpreted as maximum-likelihood estimators under simple pixel-wise residual models, corresponding to independent Gaussian variability for ℓ 2 \ell_{2} objectives and Laplacian variability for ℓ 1 \ell_{1} objectives. Limited model capacity may also attenuate high-frequency details, but this approximation effect is conceptually distinct from uncertainty contained in the supervision targets.

blocks.en: Registration residuals do not behave as independent voxel-wise intensity noise. They produce spatially coherent displacements of anatomical structures and thus introduce structured geometric label noise into the training targets. Moreover, the residual deformation field ϕ \phi is not necessarily purely random: it can contain pair-specific variability as well as systematic contributions determined by the similarity metric, regularization strategy, deformation model, or acquisition protocol.
blocks.zh: 登记残留物不具有独立的排毒强度噪音。 它们使解剖结构在空间上一致转移,从而将结构化的几何标记噪音引入培训目标。 此外,残基变形场 \\phi 不一定纯粹是随机的:它可以包含对偶的特异性,以及由相似性度量、规范化策略、变形模型或获取协议确定的系统贡献。

blocks.en: These residuals affect p ⁡ ( y ~ ∣ x ) p(\tilde{y}\mid x) in two complementary ways. Their variable component increases the dispersion of the observed target distribution because similar local input configurations may be associated with target structures displaced differently across training pairs. Voxel-wise regression, which estimates a central tendency of this distribution, may consequently produce spatially averaged or blurred boundaries. Their systematic component can instead shift the center of the distribution when the registration pipeline consistently favors a particular geometric convention. The synthesis model may then learn this convention and reproduce the spatial behavior of the registration method used to construct the training data.
blocks.zh: 这些残存以两种互补方式影响 p QQ (y ~ ∣ x) p(\tilde{y}\mid x). 它们的可变组成部分增加了观察到的目标分布的分散性,因为类似的本地投入配置可能与不同培训对子不同取代的目标结构有关。 Voxel-wise回归法估计了这种分布的中心趋势,因此可能产生空间平均或模糊的边界。 当登记管道一贯倾向于某一特定几何公约时,它们的系统组成部分反而可以改变分配中心。 然后,综合模型可以学习这一公约,并复制用于构建培训数据的登记方法的空间行为。

blocks.en: Registration-induced target uncertainty therefore provides an additional geometric explanation for the blurring observed in supervised synthesis, beyond intrinsic modality ambiguity. It cannot be resolved simply by increasing model capacity because the uncertainty lies in the training targets themselves. This setting was formalized as supervised learning with noisy labels by Kong et al. [ 6 ] , who proposed a joint registration-synthesis strategy that can theoretically recover the optimal clean-data solution under regularity assumptions on ϕ \phi . Their analysis, however, focuses on loss correction rather than on how uncorrected training reshapes p ⁡ ( y ~ ∣ x ) p(\tilde{y}\mid x) and affects uncertainty estimation and metric interpretation.
blocks.zh: 因此,登记引起的目标不确定性为在监督合成中观察到的模糊性提供了额外的几何解释,超出了固有的模式模糊性。 仅仅通过提高示范能力无法解决这个问题,因为不确定性在于培训目标本身。 Kong等人将这一设置正式确定为有监督的学习,并贴有吵闹的标签。 [6],他提出了一个联合登记-合成战略,从理论上可以恢复X\phi的规律性假设下的最佳清洁数据解决方案. 然而,他们的分析侧重于损失更正,而不是未更正的训练如何重塑p ⁡ (y ~ ∣ x) p (\tilde{y}\mid x) ,并影响不确定性估计和度量解释.

blocks.en: This form of uncertainty is distinct from both aleatoric and epistemic uncertainty. It is not inherent to the cross-modality mapping and does not primarily reflect limited model knowledge; instead, it originates from the data-construction pipeline. This distinction is rarely made explicit in the supervised synthesis literature. Blurring under MAE or MSE is commonly attributed to regression over an intrinsically ambiguous conditional distribution, whereas part of the observed ambiguity may arise from structured geometric inconsistencies in the registered targets.
blocks.zh: 这种形式的不确定性与厌食性和感知性的不确定性不同。 它并非跨模式制图的固有内容,也不主要反映有限的模型知识;相反,它源于数据建设管道。 这种区分在监督综合文献中很少明确. 在MAE或MSE下模糊通常归因于在本质上模糊的有条件分布上的回归,而所观察到的模糊部分可能来自注册目标的结构几何不一致。

blocks.en: One strategy for reducing oversmoothing is to augment voxel-wise reconstruction losses with a perceptual term computed in the feature space of a pretrained network [ 22 ] . In its original formulation, the feature extractor is typically a VGG network trained on large-scale natural-image classification. The perceptual loss can be written as: ℒ perceptual \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{perceptual}} = ‖ ψ ⁡ ( y ^ ) − ψ ⁡ ( y ) ‖ 1 , \displaystyle=\|\psi(\hat{y})-\psi(y)\|_{1}, (3) where ψ \psi denotes the feature extractor and y ^ = G θ ​ ( x ) \hat{y}=G_{\theta}(x) the synthesized image. As an ℓ 1 \ell_{1} objective in feature space, this loss can be interpreted as estimating a conditional median with respect to the representation induced by ψ \psi , rather than directly in the voxel domain. By comparing representations that encode contextual and multi-scale structure, it can promote spatially coherent anatomical patterns and reduce the oversmoothing associated with voxel-wise regression.
blocks.zh: 减少过度流畅的一个策略是,通过在预先训练的网络的特征空间中计算一个感知词来增加视狐狸的重建损失[22]。 在最初的配方中,特征提取器一般是接受大规模自然图像分类培训的VGG网络. 知觉损失可以写成: L 知觉\ displaystyle\ mathcal{ L}_{\ mathrm{ perceptitual }} ^ ^ (y ^ ^) ψ 1,\ displaystyle =\|\ psi(\hat{y})-\ psi(y)\|_{ 1},(3) 其中\ psi表示特征提取符和y = Gθ (x)\hy _{\ _{\ Theta}(x) 合成图像. 作为特征空间的l 1\ell\\1}目标,这一损失可以被解释为对\ psi 引起的表示值的有条件中位数进行估计,而不是直接在voxel域中. 通过比较编码上下文和多尺度结构的表示法,它可以促进空间一致性解剖模式,减少与阴道回归有关的过度流畅。

blocks.en: The behavior of a perceptual loss nevertheless depends critically on the selected feature representation. Features learned from natural-image classification may not optimally encode the structures relevant to medical imaging. In this study, SAM embeddings are used because they provide multi-scale representations of anatomical structures and boundaries. The resulting distance is intended to complement voxel-wise metrics by being less sensitive to small residual displacements while remaining responsive to meaningful structural differences, as detailed in Section III-C .
blocks.zh: 然而,认知损失的行为主要取决于选定的特征表现。 从自然成像分类中吸取的特征可能无法最好地编码与医学成像相关的结构. 在本研究中,使用SAM嵌入法是因为它们提供了解剖结构和边界的多尺度的表示. 如第三节-C节所详述,由此产生的距离是为了通过对小的残余流离失所问题不太敏感,同时对有意义的结构差异作出反应,从而补充对阴道测量。

blocks.en: Distribution-level objectives, including adversarial and diffusion-based approaches, can similarly improve sharpness and visual realism by counteracting the averaging behavior of voxel-wise regression [ 23 , 24 ] . However, perceptual and generative objectives do not remove the systematic component of registration-induced uncertainty when they are trained on the same imperfectly aligned pairs. They still learn from p ⁡ ( y ~ ∣ x ) p(\tilde{y}\mid x) rather than from p ⁡ ( y ∣ x ) p(y\mid x) and may therefore reproduce biases embedded in the registration pipeline.
blocks.zh: 分布式目标,包括对抗式和传播式方法,同样能够通过抵消阴道回归的平时行为[23,24],提高锐度和视觉现实性. 然而,当对登记引起的不确定性进行同样不完美的对等培训时,认知和遗传目标并不能消除这些不确定性的系统性组成部分。 他们仍然从p ⁡ (y ~ ∣ x) p (\tilde{y}\mid x) 而不是从 p ⁡ (y∣ x) p (y\mid x) 学习,因此可能复制嵌入注册管道的偏见.

blocks.en: Voxel-wise supervised translation is well suited to settings with reliable spatial correspondence. When residual registration errors are structured or systematic, however, regression objectives may both smooth uncertain boundaries and shift anatomical structures toward the geometric convention imposed by the registration pipeline.
blocks.zh: Voxel-wiside 监督翻译非常适合具有可靠空间通信的设置. 然而,如果剩余登记误差是结构化的或系统的,回归目标既可以平滑不确定的边界,又可以将解剖结构转向登记管道规定的几何公约。

blocks.en: This limitation remains insufficiently characterized in the recent literature [ 5 , 25 , 26 ] , where evaluation protocols predominantly emphasize intensity-based similarity rather than anatomical faithfulness. Benchmarking may consequently favor models that reproduce registration-induced distortions rather than models that best preserve clinically relevant structures. This is particularly problematic when the clinical motivation for synthetic CT is to avoid uncertain inter-modality registration, for example by generating CT-like images directly from MRI.
blocks.zh: 这一限制在最近的文献[5、25、26]中仍然没有得到充分描述,其中评价协议主要强调基于强度的相似性,而不是解剖的忠实性。 因此,制订基准可能有利于复制登记引起的扭曲的模型,而不是最佳保存临床相关结构的模型。 如果合成CT的临床动机是为了避免不确定的跨模式登记,例如直接从核磁共振中生成类似CT的图像,就特别有问题。

blocks.en: Improving spatial correspondence is a natural response, and several methods jointly optimize synthesis and registration [ 6 , 8 , 27 ] . Nevertheless, residual misalignment remains difficult to eliminate completely, especially under large anatomical deformations. Unsupervised or weakly paired methods relax the requirement for exact voxel-wise correspondence, but introduce other challenges related to anatomical consistency, training stability, and quantitative validation. The present study therefore focuses on quantifying registration-induced bias in supervised synthesis and examining its consequences for uncertainty estimation and sCT evaluation, as further discussed in Section V .
blocks.zh: 改进空间通信是一种自然反应,几种方法共同优化合成和注册[6,8,27]. 尽管如此,残余的错位仍然难以完全消除,特别是在大解剖变形的情况下. 无监督或薄弱的配对方法放宽了精确的voxel-wise的对应要求,但提出了与解剖一致性、训练稳定性和定量验证有关的其他挑战。 因此,本研究报告的重点是量化监督综合中登记引起的偏差,并审查其对不确定性估计和SCT评估的影响,第五节对此作了进一步讨论。

blocks.en: III Supervised Cross-Modality Image Synthesis: Experimental Study on SynthRAD
blocks.zh: 三. 监督的交叉模式 图像合成:合成雷达实验研究

blocks.en: In this section, we consider the standard supervised formulation of cross-modality image synthesis, as commonly adopted in recent benchmarks. Given spatially aligned image pairs, a model is trained to predict CT images from input CBCT or MRI data using voxel-wise reconstruction losses.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们认为最近的基准通常采用的标准监督下的跨模式图像合成。 鉴于空间对齐的图像对,培训了一个模型,通过输入CBCT或核磁共振数据预测CT图像,利用阴道重建损失。

blocks.en: This setting constitutes the dominant paradigm in current evaluation frameworks, where performance is primarily assessed through intensity-based similarity metrics computed with respect to a reference CT.
blocks.zh: 这一设定构成当前评价框架中的主要范式,在这一范式中,业绩主要通过参照CT计算的强度相似度衡量尺度来评估。

blocks.en: III-A SynthRAD challenge and datasets
blocks.zh: 三-A 合成雷达的挑战和数据集

blocks.en: Experiments were conducted using the SynthRAD2023 and SynthRAD2025 datasets [ 28 , 29 ] , which contain paired images for two synthesis tasks: MR-to-CT (Task 1) and CBCT-to-CT (Task 2). The datasets cover brain, head-and-neck, thoracic, abdominal, and pelvic anatomies, depending on the task and challenge edition. Training pairs were provided after rigid registration, whereas the hidden validation and test sets enabled evaluation under the official challenge protocol. This structure makes the dataset particularly suitable for studying how the choice of registration convention affects both model training and performance assessment.
blocks.zh: 使用SynthRAD2023和SynthRAD2025数据集[28,29]进行了实验,这些数据集包含两个合成任务的配对图像:MR-TT(任务1)和CBCT-T(任务2). 数据集根据任务和挑战版的不同,涵盖大脑,头颈,胸肌,腹腔,盆腔解剖. 在严格注册后提供了培训配对,而隐藏的验证和测试则使得能够根据正式质疑协议进行评价。 这一结构使得数据集特别适合研究选择登记公约如何影响示范培训和业绩评估。

blocks.en:
The official image-similarity metrics were mean absolute error (MAE), peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR), and multi-scale structural similarity (MS-SSIM); the local analyses report SSIM. Dose-based metrics were also reported by the challenge but were
used here only to document the official benchmark performance. Dataset composition and complete evaluation details are provided in Appendix A and in the SynthRAD references [ 28 , 29 ] .
blocks.zh:
官方的图像-同质性衡量标准是:平均绝对错误(MAE)、峰值信号-噪声比(PSNR)和多尺度结构相似性(MS-SSIM);当地分析报告SSIM。 挑战还报告了基于剂量的衡量标准,但
这里仅用于记录官方基准性能. 数据集组成和完整的评价细节载于附录A和SynthRAD参考文献[28,29]。

blocks.en: III-B Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 三-B 实验装置

blocks.en: The overall study design is summarized in Fig. 1 , which links the construction of registered supervision targets, the supervised synthesis model, and the complementary evaluation analyses used to assess registration-induced bias.
blocks.zh: 图1概述了总体研究设计,其中将注册监管目标的构建、监督综合模型以及用于评估登记所致偏差的补充评价分析联系起来。

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Overview of the synthesis and evaluation protocol used to study registration-induced bias. Paired MR/CBCT and planning CT data are first converted into supervised training pairs through ELX or IMPACT registration conventions, yielding registered CT targets used as supervision labels for a 2.5D U-Net++ trained with MAE, VGG, or SAM-based objectives. Rectangular blocks denote data, targets, or outputs, whereas rounded blocks denote processing modules, training components, metrics, or analysis toolboxes; dashed blocks indicate independent or OOD evaluation geometries. The resulting synthetic CT images are evaluated using reference-based, anatomy-oriented, and dose-based metrics, complemented by independent/OOD test settings and CT-derived controls that isolate robustness and registration-induced metric sensitivity. Small tags indicate where the corresponding protocol components and analyses are defined in the manuscript. The robustness and benchmark branch distinguishes the independent/OOD geometry from ELX- and IMPACT-based evaluation registrations.
blocks.zh: 费格。 1: 用于研究登记所致偏差的综合和评价协议概述。 Paired MR/CBCT和规划CT数据首先通过ELX或IMPACT登记公约转换成监督培训对联,产生注册的CT目标,作为以MAE、VGG或基于SAM目标培训的2.5D U-Net++的监督标签。 矩形区块表示数据、目标或输出,而圆形区块表示处理模块、培训组件、指标或分析工具箱;破碎区块表示独立或OD评价几何。 利用基于参考、以解剖学为导向和以剂量为基准的度量衡,对由此产生的合成CT图像进行评价,并辅之以独立的/OOD测试设置和CT衍生控制,这些控制将强健性和登记引起的度量灵敏度隔离开来。 小标记表示手稿中定义了相应的协议组件和分析. 稳健性和基准分支将独立/OOD几何与基于ELX和IMPACT的评价登记区分开来.

blocks.en: Although the dataset is provided as paired multimodal acquisitions, the correspondence between modalities is not intrinsically voxel-wise. MRI, CBCT, and CT scans are acquired at different time points and under different physiological conditions, leading to non-negligible anatomical discrepancies.
blocks.zh: 虽然数据集是作为配对的多式联运采购提供的,但不同方式之间的对应性本质上并不是按不同方式进行的。 核磁共振,CBCT,和CT扫描在不同的时间点和不同的生理条件下获得,导致不可忽略的解剖差异.

blocks.en: To study the impact of spatial correspondence on supervised synthesis while remaining consistent with the official challenge evaluation protocol, we investigate two different registration strategies for constructing the training pairs.
blocks.zh: 为了研究空间通信对监督合成的影响,同时与正式质疑评价协议保持一致,我们调查了两种不同的注册战略,以构建培训对子.

blocks.en:
First, we consider the registration pipeline used for the test set by the challenge organizers. This approach relies on a multi-resolution deformable registration framework implemented in Elastix [ 30 ] , using a mutual-information-based similarity metric representative of standard practice in radiotherapy workflows and supervised sCT synthesis studies.
In the remainder of this manuscript, this registration configuration is referred to as ELX .
blocks.zh:
首先,我们考虑的是挑战组织者为测试设定的登记管道。 这种方法依赖于在Elastix[30]中实施的多分辨率变形登记框架,使用基于相互信息的类似性衡量标准来代表放射疗法工作流程中的标准做法,并监督SCT综合研究。
在本手稿的其余部分,这个注册配置被称为ELX.

blocks.en:
Second, we investigate an alternative registration strategy based on IMPACT-Reg [ 31 ] , a feature-based multimodal registration method leveraging deep semantic representations.
Unlike intensity-based approaches, IMPACT-Reg relies on high-level feature correspondences to estimate multimodal anatomical alignment.
In the remainder of this manuscript, this registration configuration is referred to as IMPACT .
Neither ELX nor IMPACT is assumed to provide ground-truth anatomical correspondence. They are treated as two alternative registration conventions whose residual errors may differ. IMPACT is used here because its alignments show higher anatomical consistency than ELX according to the segmentation-based analyses reported below, not because it is considered an exact reference.
blocks.zh:
第二,我们调查基于IMPACT-Reg[31]的替代登记战略,这是一种利用深层语义表述的基于特征的多式联运登记方法。
与基于强度的方法不同,IMPACT-Reg依赖于高层次的特征对应来估计多式联运解剖配合.
在本手稿的其余部分,这一注册配置被称为IMPACT.
ELX或impactACT均不被认为提供地面真实解剖通信。 它们被作为两个其他登记公约处理,其剩余错误可能有所不同。 此处使用IMPACT是因为根据下文报告的分解分析,它的对齐显示的解剖一致性高于ELX,而不是因为它被认为是确切的参考.

blocks.en: III-B 1 Training and inference
blocks.zh: 训练和推断

blocks.en: All images were resampled and intensity-normalized before training. We used a 2.5D U-Net++ architecture with a ResNet-34 encoder [ 32 ] that predicts the central sCT slice from adjacent input slices. Models were optimized with the loss described below, and checkpoints were selected according to validation MAE. Predictions from the retained models were averaged at inference time. Complete preprocessing, architecture, optimization, and inference parameters are provided in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 所有图像在训练前都重新取样和强度正常化。 我们使用了2.5D U-Net++架构,并配有ResNet-34编码器[32],从相邻的输入切片中预言了中央SCT切片. 采用以下描述的损失方式优化了型号,并根据验证MAE选择了检查站. 保留模型的预测是在推断时间平均得出的。 附录B提供了完整的预处理、结构、优化和推论参数。

blocks.en: The objective of this work is not to introduce a new architecture, but to use a reliable and efficient supervised baseline for studying the effect of registration-induced supervision bias. The 2.5D U-Net++ provides a practical compromise between anatomical context, computational cost, and deployment simplicity.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的目的不是引入一个新的架构,而是使用可靠和有效的监督基线来研究登记引起的监督偏差的影响。 2.5D U-Net++在解剖上下文、计算成本和部署简便之间提供了实际妥协。

blocks.en: III-C SAM-based perceptual supervision
blocks.zh: 三-C SAM概念监督

blocks.en: We investigate the impact of SAM-based perceptual supervision by comparing two training objectives: a standard voxel-wise reconstruction loss and an augmented objective combining voxel-wise and feature-based constraints. This subsection describes only the losses used for model optimization; the separately calibrated SAM-based evaluation metric is introduced in Section III-D .
blocks.zh: 我们通过比较两个培训目标来调查基于SAM的知觉监督的影响:一个是标准Voxel的重建损失,另一个是将Voxel和基于特征的制约因素结合起来的扩大目标。 本小节仅描述用于模型优化的损失;第三节D部分引入了单独校准的基于SAM的评价度量衡.

blocks.en: The baseline model is trained using a standard ℓ 1 \ell_{1} loss, defined as: ℒ MAE = ‖ y ^ − y ‖ 1 , \mathcal{L}_{\text{MAE}}=\left\|\hat{y}-y\right\|_{1}, (4) where y ^ \hat{y} denotes the synthesized CT image and y y the reference CT.
blocks.zh: 基准模型使用标准 l 1\ell\\1} 损失进行训练, 定义为: L MAE = ‖ y ^ ^ − 1,\ mathcal{ L}_{\text{ MAE}}=\left{ y} -y\right\1}, (4) y ^\ hat{y} 表示合成的 CT 图像和 y 的参考 CT。

blocks.en: This formulation corresponds to the dominant paradigm in supervised sCT generation, where the model is optimized to minimize voxel-wise discrepancies between paired images, in accordance with the MAE-based evaluation criterion commonly used in the field.
blocks.zh: 这种配方与受监督的SCT生成中的主要范式相对应,按照实地常用的基于MAE的评价标准,对模型进行优化,以尽量减少成对图像之间的阴离子差异.

blocks.en: To complement voxel-level supervision, we introduce a perceptual loss defined in the feature space of a pretrained segmentation model.
blocks.zh: 为了补充Voxel级的监管,我们引入了一种预训分解模型的特征空间中定义的知觉损失.

blocks.en: Classical perceptual losses commonly rely on networks trained on natural images (e.g., VGG). Instead, we use the frozen encoder of the Segment Anything Model (SAM), in its SAM 2 version based on the Hiera hierarchical transformer architecture, as a feature extractor [ 33 ] . The encoder parameters remain fixed throughout synthesis-model training and provide multi-scale feature representations for comparing the synthesized and reference CT images.
blocks.zh: 古典感官损失通常依赖于接受自然图像(如VGG)训练的网络. 相反,我们使用基于Hiera分级变压器架构的SAM 2 版本的SACY Anything Model(SAM)的冷冻编码器作为特性提取器[33]. 编码器参数在整个合成-模型培训中保持不变,并提供多尺度的特征表示,用于比较合成和参考的CT图像。

blocks.en: Let ψ ⁡ ( ⋅ ) \psi(\cdot) denote the frozen SAM encoder. The perceptual loss is defined as: ℒ SAM \displaystyle\mathcal{L}_{\text{SAM}} = ∑ l ∈ 𝒮 w l ​ Δ l , \displaystyle=\sum_{l\in\mathcal{S}}w_{l}\,\Delta_{l}, (5) Δ l \displaystyle\Delta_{l} = ‖ ψ l ​ ( y ^ ) − ψ l ​ ( y ) ‖ 1 , \displaystyle=\left\|\psi_{l}(\hat{y})-\psi_{l}(y)\right\|_{1}, where ψ l ​ ( ⋅ ) \psi_{l}(\cdot) denotes the feature map extracted at layer l l .

In practice, features are extracted from four hierarchical levels of the encoder.
Only the two intermediate feature maps are used, corresponding to a weighting scheme of ( 0 , 1 , 1 , 0 ) (0,1,1,0) .
This selection targets representations that capture anatomical structures at an appropriate level of abstraction, avoiding both low-level noise sensitivity and overly coarse semantic features.
blocks.zh:
在实际操作中,从编码器的四个层次上提取特征.
只使用两个中间特征图,对应的加权方案为(0, 1, 1, 0) (0, 1, 1, 0).
这种选择针对的是以适当的抽象程度捕捉解剖结构的表述,避免低级噪声敏感性和过于粗糙的语义特征.

blocks.en: The final training objective is defined as: ℒ total = ℒ MAE + ℒ SAM , \mathcal{L}_{\text{total}}=\mathcal{L}_{\text{MAE}}+\mathcal{L}_{\text{SAM}}, (6) where both terms are equally weighted.
blocks.zh: 最终的训练目标被定义为: L 总计 = L MAE + L SAM,\ mathcal{L}_{\text{total}}=\mathcal{L}_{\text{MAE}}+\mathcal{L}_{\text{SAM}}},(6) 两个术语都同等加权.

blocks.en:
Rather than relying on extensive hyperparameter tuning, this formulation is intentionally kept simple to assess the intrinsic contribution of perceptual supervision.
A method that remains effective under minimal tuning is more likely to generalize across datasets and clinical conditions.
blocks.zh:
这种配方不是依赖广泛的超参数调制,而是有意保持简单,以评估感知监督的内在贡献。
在最低调试下仍然有效的方法更有可能将数据集和临床条件概括起来。

blocks.en: III-D SAM-based perceptual evaluation metric
blocks.zh: 基于SAM的感知评价度量表

blocks.en: Separately from the training objective described in Section III-C , we define a calibrated SAM-based perceptual distance for anatomy-oriented evaluation. The SAM-based metric is computed only after model training and is not used to optimize the synthesis network or to select its checkpoints. In the spirit of LPIPS [ 34 ] , SAM provides the feature representation, while separately learned channel-wise weights calibrate the contribution of the selected features to the final distance.
blocks.zh: 与第三节-C节所述培训目标分开,我们界定了以SAM为基础的经校准的感知距离,用于以解剖学为导向的评估。 基于SAM的衡量标准是在模型培训后计算出来的,不用于优化合成网络或选择其检查站。 以LPIPS [34]的精神,SAM提供特色表现,而单独学习的频道-睿智加权将所选特征的贡献校准到最终距离.

blocks.en: The objective is to calibrate the feature-space distance so that it better discriminates the structural defects typically produced by MAE-trained synthetic CT models from the residual discrepancies caused by imperfect registration.
blocks.zh: 目标是校准特征-空间距离,以便更好地区分通常由MAE训练的合成CT模型产生的结构缺陷和登记不完善造成的剩余差异。

blocks.en: Starting from the SAM-based distance defined above, we introduce channel-wise weights α l , c \alpha_{l,c} applied to the feature discrepancies at each selected layer. These weights are optimized from precomputed feature differences rather than fixed heuristically. The calibration is designed to emphasize feature channels that distinguish a sharp CT image affected by residual alignment errors from a synthetic CT prediction affected by regression-induced blurring or structural inaccuracies.
blocks.zh: 从上面定义的基于 SAM 的距离开始,我们引入适用于每个选定层的特性差异的频道加权 α l, c\ alpha_{l, c}。 这些权重是从预算的特征差异中优化而来,而不是固定的高度. 校准旨在强调特征通道,将受剩余对齐误差影响的锐度CT图像与受回归引起的模糊或结构不准确影响的合成CT预测区分开来.

blocks.en: Calibration is performed once on development cases only, before final evaluation. For each selected SAM layer, absolute feature differences are spatially averaged per channel and normalized using calibration-set statistics. blocks.en: III-E Experimental configurations
blocks.zh: 三-E 实验配置

blocks.en: In the experimental study, we compare two synthesis objectives and two registration strategies: • MAE: synthesis model trained with the voxel-wise reconstruction loss ℒ MAE \mathcal{L}_{\text{MAE}} only; • SAM: synthesis model trained with the combined objective ℒ total \mathcal{L}_{\text{total}} , including SAM-based perceptual supervision; • ELX: training pairs constructed using the official Elastix-based registration pipeline; • IMPACT: training pairs constructed using the IMPACT-Reg registration pipeline.
blocks.zh: 在实验性研究中,我们比较了两个综合目标和两个登记战略: MAE:仅与Voxel-wisele重建损失L MAE\Mathcal{L}_{\Text{MAE}一起培训的合成模型; SAM:以L总\Mathcal{L}_{\text{total}一起目标培训的合成模型,包括基于SAM的知觉监督; ELX:使用基于Elastix的官方登记管道建造的培训对对; IMPACT:使用IMPACT-Reg登记管道建造的培训对.

blocks.en: MAE: synthesis model trained with the voxel-wise reconstruction loss ℒ MAE \mathcal{L}_{\text{MAE}} only;
blocks.zh: MAE: 仅用Voxel-wiside重建损失L MAE\mathcal{L}_{\text{MAE}训练的合成模型;

blocks.en: SAM: synthesis model trained with the combined objective ℒ total \mathcal{L}_{\text{total}} , including SAM-based perceptual supervision;
blocks.zh: SAM: 结合目标L总\ mathcal{L}_{\text{total}训练的合成模型,包括基于SAM的知觉监督;

blocks.en: ELX: training pairs constructed using the official Elastix-based registration pipeline;
blocks.zh: ELX:使用正式的基于Elastix的登记管道建造的训练对;

blocks.en: IMPACT: training pairs constructed using the IMPACT-Reg registration pipeline.
blocks.zh: IMPACT:使用IMPACT-Reg登记管道建造的训练配对.

blocks.en: We adopt a held-out evaluation protocol combined with five-fold cross-validation for model development. For each task, 15% of the available cases are excluded from training and reserved for final testing, while the remaining data are used to train five independent models subsequently combined through ensembling at inference time. The evaluation branches in Fig. 1 summarize the three complementary analyses used below: reference-based metrics, anatomy- and dose-oriented assessment, and robustness/sensitivity controls.
blocks.zh: 我们通过一个搁置的评价协议,同时进行五倍的交叉验证,以开发模型。 在每项任务中,15%的可用案例被排除在培训之外,并留作最后测试,其余数据则用于培训五个独立模型,随后通过推论时间的综艺组合。 图1中的评价分支总结了以下三个补充分析:参考度量衡、以解剖学和剂量为导向的评估以及强健性/敏感性控制。

blocks.en: The final evaluation protocol relies on three complementary test settings.
blocks.zh: 最后的评价协议依赖于三个互补的测试设置.

blocks.en:
(1) In-distribution (ID) evaluation. The ID test set corresponds to the 66 held-out cases from SynthRAD2025 (AB = 22, HN = 21, TH = 23).
For this subset, two versions of the data are considered: the ELX-based non-rigid registration provided by the organizers and our IMPACT-based non-rigid registration. These two aligned references are used to evaluate the sensitivity of quantitative metrics to the choice of registration under in-distribution conditions.
blocks.zh:
(1)分配(ID)评价. ID测试集对应SynthRAD2025的66个搁置病例(AB=22,HN=21,TH=23).
对于这个子集,考虑了两个版本的数据:组织者提供的基于ELX的非硬化登记和我们的基于IMPACT的非硬化登记. 这两处对齐的参照用于评价定量衡量标准在分配条件下选择登记时的敏感性。

blocks.en:
(2) Out-of-distribution (OOD) evaluation with SynthRAD2023. The OOD test set includes 50 cases from SynthRAD2023 (brain = 27, pelvis = 23).
Similarly to the ID setting, both ELX-based and IMPACT-based registrations are used to generate two evaluation references. Notably, the ELX registration corresponds to a rigid alignment, consistent with the original evaluation setup of the challenge, while IMPACT provides a non-rigid alternative. This setting allows us to assess the impact of registration differences in a more challenging OOD scenario.
blocks.zh:
(2)与SynthRAD2023进行分配外(OO)评价. OOD测试集包括来自SynthRAD2023的50例(脑=27,骨盆=23).
与ID设置类似,基于ELX和IMPACT的注册都用于生成两个评价参考文献. 值得注意的是,ELX登记符合挑战的最初评价安排,而IMPACT则提供了非固定的替代办法。 这种设定使我们能够在更具挑战性的OD情景下评估登记差异的影响。

blocks.en:
(3) OOD evaluation with expert-refined alignment (Ext-T2). Finally, we evaluate the model on an external OOD dataset composed of 24 T2-weighted MRI cases [ 35 ] .
This dataset represents a particularly severe OOD setting, as no T2-weighted MRI data are included in the training set.
The dataset further provides high-quality voxel-wise alignment between MRI and CT, obtained through a single reference alignment manually refined by experts.
blocks.zh:
(3) 经专家精细调整的OD评价(Ext-T2)。 最后,我们评价由24个T2加权磁共振病例组成的外部OD数据集模型[35]。
这个数据集代表着一种特别严重的OOD设置,因为训练集中没有T2加权磁共振数据.
该数据集进一步提供了磁共振与电磁共振之间高质量的阴离子对齐,通过专家手工改进的单一参考对齐获得.

blocks.en: In contrast to the previous settings, this dataset relies on a unique reference, removing variability induced by different registration methods and providing an expert-refined evaluation setting with reduced registration uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 与以往的设置不同,该数据集依赖独特的参考,消除了不同登记方法引起的变异性,提供了一种经过专家改进的、登记不确定性较小的评价环境。

blocks.en: The evaluation protocol for Task 2 relies on two complementary test settings based on the SynthRAD2025 dataset.
blocks.zh: 任务2的评价协议依赖于基于SynthRAD2025数据集的两个互补测试设置.

blocks.en:
(1) Real CBCT evaluation. The first setting uses the 103 held-out SynthRAD2025 cases, where CBCT and CT are acquired independently (AB = 32, HN = 37, TH = 34).
Similarly to Task 1, two versions of the data are considered using ELX-based and IMPACT-based registrations to define the evaluation reference.
blocks.zh:
(1)真正的CBCT评价. 第一个设置使用103个被搁置的SynthRAD2025案例,其中CBCT和CT是独立获得的(AB=32,HN=37,TH=34).
与任务1类似,考虑使用基于ELX和IMPACT的登记来界定评价参考。

blocks.en:
(2) Simulated CBCT evaluation (Sim-CBCT, registration-free). To isolate the effect of registration bias, we construct a second evaluation set by generating simulated CBCT volumes from the same 103 CT images.
These simulated CBCT volumes are obtained by forward-projecting the planning CT using an RTK-based [ 36 ] cone-beam simulation pipeline, followed by projection degradation and FDK reconstruction.
blocks.zh:
(2) CBCT模拟评价(Sim-CBCT,无注册). 为了隔离登记偏差的影响,我们从同样的103 CT 图像中生成模拟的 CBCT 卷来构建第二个评价集。
这些模拟CBCT量是通过使用基于RTK的[36]锥梁模拟管道进行规划CT的远期预测,然后是投影退化和FDK重建得到的.

blocks.en: Because the simulated CBCT is generated directly from the CT volume, the anatomical correspondence between input and reference is preserved by construction. This removes the inter-modality registration uncertainty present in real CBCT-CT pairs and provides a controlled setting where quantitative metrics directly reflect synthesis quality.
blocks.zh: 由于模拟的CBCT直接由CT卷产生,所以输入和参考之间的解剖对应通过构造保存. 这消除了真实的CBCT-CT配对中存在的模式间登记不确定性,并提供了一个可控的设定,定量计量直接反映合成质量.

blocks.en: However, the simulated CBCT volumes do not perfectly reproduce real acquisitions. Hounsfield units are not fully calibrated, and some CT volumes are truncated, leading to differences in field-of-view compared to clinical CBCT scans. The simulation therefore does not strictly match the physical acquisition process of real CBCT, and noticeable intensity and boundary discrepancies may arise. Nevertheless, the simulated data capture the main characteristics of CBCT imaging, providing a realistic yet controlled approximation suitable for analysis.
blocks.zh: 然而,模拟的CBCT卷并没有完全复制真实的收购. Hounsfield单位没有完全校准,一些CT卷被截断,导致与临床CBCT扫描相比的视场差异. 因此,模拟并不严格符合实际CBCT的物理获取过程,并可能产生明显的强度和边界差异。 尽管如此,模拟数据还是能够捕捉到CBCT成像的主要特征,提供了一种现实的但可控制的近似,适合分析.

blocks.zh: 三-F 统计分析

For each anatomical region and experimental configuration, results are reported as the mean and standard deviation across patients. Comparisons between models or registration configurations were performed on matched patients using two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank tests. The patient, rather than the slice or the cross-validation fold, was treated as the statistical unit. Statistical significance is denoted by ∗ p adj < 0.05 {}^{*}p_{\mathrm{adj}}<0.05 , p adj ∗ ⁣ ∗ < 0.01 {}^{**}p_{\mathrm{adj}}<0.01 , and ∗ ∗ ∗ p adj < 0.001 {}^{***}p_{\mathrm{adj}}<0.001 .

blocks.en: For ensemble results (CV), the five cross-validation predictions were averaged voxel-wise for each patient before computing the evaluation metrics. For Mean CV results, each metric was first computed for every fold-specific prediction and patient, then averaged across the five folds for that patient before calculating group-level summary statistics. Thus, folds were not treated as independent statistical observations.
blocks.zh: 对于共性结果(CV),在计算评价指标之前,每名患者的5个交叉验证预测值是平均的。 就平均CV结果而言,首先为每个折叠具体预测和病人计算每个度量,然后在计算小组一级汇总统计之前为该病人计算五折叠的平均值。 因此,折叠不被视为独立的统计观察。

blocks.en: III-G Qualitative comparison of IMPACT and ELX registrations
blocks.zh: 三-G 影响控制中心与ELX登记的质量比较

blocks.en: As a preliminary step before assessing the impact of registration on training and evaluation in cross-modality image synthesis, qualitative comparisons between IMPACT- and ELX-based registrations across several anatomical regions (AB, HN, TH) in the MR → \rightarrow CT setting are provided in Appendix Figure 4 .
blocks.zh: 在评估登记对跨模式图像综合培训和评价的影响之前,附录图4提供了在MR →\直径CT环境中对几个解剖区(AB、HN、TH)基于IMPACT和ELX的登记进行定性比较。

blocks.en: Both registration approaches produce visually plausible and globally coherent alignments across the three anatomical regions considered. At the scale of the full volume, structural correspondences between MR and CT are largely established in both cases, although residual anatomical discrepancies remain visible in regions subject to large deformations, including the diaphragm and soft tissue boundaries. This stands in contrast to the rigid-only alignment adopted in the SynthRAD2023 edition, which left substantially larger residual discrepancies between modalities. In the present setting, both ELX and IMPACT perform deformable non-rigid registration, and ELX already represents the level of registration quality commonly used in supervised synthetic CT studies. The observed differences should therefore be interpreted as refinements over an already credible and clinically realistic alignment rather than as a fundamental reliability gap. It is also important to note that the effects reported in the following sections are obtained despite this relatively strong registration baseline; under the rigid-only alignment setup used in the SynthRAD2023 edition, the observed differences and their impact on supervised synthesis would likely have been substantially larger.
blocks.zh: 这两种登记办法在所审议的三个解剖区都产生了明显可信的全球协调。 在全体体积的规模上,MR和CT之间的结构对应在这两种情况下都基本建立,尽管残余的解剖差异在存在大变形的区域仍然明显,包括隔膜和软组织边界. 这与SynthRAD2023版采用的僵硬的单调一致形成对比,这在模式之间留下了大得多的剩余差异. 在目前情况下,ELX和IMPACT都进行可变形的非硬化登记,而ELX已经代表了监督合成CT研究中常用的登记质量水平. 因此,所观察到的差异应被解释为对已经可信和临床上现实的调整的改进,而不是基本的可靠性差距。 还必须指出,尽管登记基线相对较强,但以下各节中所报告的影响还是得到的;在SynthRAD-2023版采用的僵硬的只调整结构下,观察到的差异及其对监督合成的影响很可能要大得多。

blocks.en: These qualitative observations are complemented by the structure-wise Dice analysis reported in Table I . The table summarizes the mean Dice coefficient obtained after registration for each anatomical region. Higher Dice values indicate greater agreement between the registered CT structures and the source-modality anatomy captured by the segmentation analysis. They therefore support the use of IMPACT as an alternative supervision convention with higher measured anatomical consistency on average, without establishing it as a ground-truth alignment.
blocks.zh: 这些定性观测得到表一中报告的结构滴分析的补充。 该表总结了每个解剖区域登记后获得的平均剂量系数。 较高的剂量值表明,已登记的CT结构与分解分析所捕获的源模式解剖学之间有更大的一致。 因此,他们支持将“影响控制”作为一种替代监督公约,平均而言,它具有较高的经衡量的解剖一致性,但并不确立它为地面-事实一致性。

blocks.en: TABLE I: Mean Dice coefficient per anatomical region for the evaluated registration approaches. Higher values indicate better anatomical alignment between the registered source-modality structures and the reference CT structures.
blocks.zh: 表格 一:经评估的登记办法,每个解剖区域的平均剂量系数。 较高的数值表明,登记源模式结构与参考CT结构之间的解剖结构更加一致。

blocks.en: Overall, IMPACT achieves a modest average Dice increase over ELX, from 0.724 to 0.758, although the direction of the difference is not uniform across every region. Together with the qualitative observations, these results define two alternative supervision conventions with different measured levels of anatomical consistency.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,IMPACT比ELX的平均剂量增长幅度不大,从0.724增至0.758,尽管各区域的差异方向并不一致。 这些结果与定性观察一起,界定了两个具有不同程度的解剖一致性的替代监督公约。

blocks.en: IV Results
blocks.zh: 四. 结果

blocks.en: IV-A Effect of Registration Consistency Between Training and Evaluation
blocks.zh: 培训与评价之间保持登记一致性的效果

blocks.en: Table II summarizes the aggregate in-distribution results for all combinations of registration strategies used during training and evaluation. The first term in each configuration denotes the registration used to construct the training targets, whereas the second denotes the registration used to define the evaluation reference. Complete region-wise results, including patient-level variability and statistical comparisons, are reported in Appendix C-A , Tables XIV and XV .
blocks.zh: 表二汇总了培训和评价期间使用的所有登记战略组合的分布结果。 每个组合中的第一个术语表示用于构建培训目标的登记,第二个术语表示用于界定评价参考的登记。 附录C-A、表十四和表十五汇报了按区域分列的完整结果,包括病人水平的可变性和统计比较。

blocks.en: TABLE II: Aggregate in-distribution performance for all combinations of registration strategies used during training and evaluation. Results are pooled across the AB, HN, and TH regions. Complete regional results are reported in Appendix C-A .
blocks.zh: 表格 二:在培训和评价期间使用的所有登记战略组合的汇总分配业绩。 各个AB、HN和TH区域都汇集了成果。 附录C-A报告了完整的区域结果。

blocks.en: Across both tasks, the best voxel-wise performance is obtained when the registration strategy used for training and evaluation is matched. In Task 1, IMPACT/IMPACT reaches an aggregate MAE of 63.55, compared with 72.47 when the same model is evaluated against ELX references. In Task 2, the same pattern is stronger, with MAE increasing from 58.76 to 69.17 under evaluation mismatch. The effect is asymmetric: evaluation mismatch degrades IMPACT-trained models by 14.0% (Task 1) and 17.7% (Task 2), but ELX-trained models by only 2.0% and 7.2%, which still remain above IMPACT/IMPACT. This behavior indicates that supervised models do not only learn a modality translation mapping, but also partially adapt to the geometric convention imposed by the registration pipeline.
blocks.zh: 在这两项任务中,如果用于培训和评价的登记战略相匹配,则能取得最佳的排毒性能。 在任务1中,IMPACT/IMPACT达到总的MAE为63.55,而当参照ELX标准评价同一模型时则为72.47。 在任务2中,同样的模式更为强烈,评价不匹配的MAE从58.76增加到69.17。 效果不对称:评价不匹配使IMPACT训练的模型降解了14.0%(任务1)和17.7%(任务2),但ELX训练的模型只降解了2.0%和7.2%,这些模型仍然高于IMPACT/IMPACT. 这种行为表明,被监督的模型不仅学习一种模式的翻译映射,而且部分地适应了注册管道强加的几何常规.

blocks.en: This effect becomes more pronounced in OOD regions. The same dependence is observed in the SynthRAD2023 brain and pelvis regions, where the difference between the rigid-only ELX convention and the IMPACT deformable convention is larger. In these regions, ELX-trained models even score better against IMPACT than against the rigid ELX references, consistent with their deformable training targets being geometrically closer to IMPACT than to a rigid alignment. IMPACT/IMPACT nevertheless remains the best configuration. Full regional results are provided in Appendix C-A .

blocks.en: Interestingly, the top-performing methods reported in the original SynthRAD2023 challenge achieved substantially lower voxel-wise errors under this rigid-registration setting, reaching 58.83 ± 13.41 58.83\pm 13.41 HU MAE, 29.61 ± 1.79 29.61\pm 1.79 dB PSNR, and 0.885 ± 0.029 0.885\pm 0.029 SSIM for Task 1. These results were obtained using a supervised synthesis framework conceptually close to the one proposed in this work, but trained directly on rigidly aligned image pairs, therefore matching the registration convention used during evaluation. This further indicates that strong in-distribution voxel-wise performance can still be achieved even with imperfectly aligned training pairs, provided that the same alignment convention is consistently used during both training and evaluation.

blocks.en: Figure 2 presents a qualitative comparison of synthetic CT images generated from the same MR input using ELX- and IMPACT-based training. Both models produce visually plausible CT-like outputs with globally coherent intensity distributions. However, a clear anatomical inconsistency is observed in the ELX-trained output: the diaphragm region is severely distorted, with the cardiac silhouette and inferior lung boundaries displaced in a manner that does not correspond to the source MR anatomy. This deformation is not present in the MR input and represents a spurious anatomical configuration introduced by the synthesis model. In contrast, the IMPACT-trained model, trained using more geometrically consistent image pairs than ELX, preserves the diaphragm position and overall thoracic anatomy in a configuration consistent with the source image, with sharper pulmonary contours and more faithful mediastinal structure delineation.

blocks.en: Table IV presents prediction uncertainty estimated from the variance across 15 synthesized predictions per patient, corresponding to the combination of five cross-validation models and three test-time augmentations (original, horizontal flip, and vertical flip). Results are reported for models trained using the voxel-wise MAE criterion. Uncertainty is systematically higher for ELX-trained models than for IMPACT-trained models across both tasks. In Task 1, in-distribution regions show relative uncertainty increases ranging from 20.7% (HN and TH) to 41.2% (AB), with an aggregate increase of 29.7%. In Task 2, the same trend is observed but with more variable magnitude, ranging from 1.2% (HN) to 27.6% (AB), with an aggregate increase of 12.5%. In Task 1, uncertainty differences become substantially larger in OOD settings, reaching 116.1% for the pelvis, while the Ext-T2 increase reaches 61.8%. The brain region constitutes a partial exception, with a more limited uncertainty increase of 2.7%, consistent with its lower overall performance gap between registration strategies. Overall, ELX-trained models exhibit greater prediction variability than IMPACT-trained models, indicating that synthesized predictions vary more strongly from one inference configuration to another when the models are trained on less geometrically consistent image pairs.

blocks.en: IV-C Anatomical consistency
blocks.zh: 四-C 解剖一致性

blocks.en:
The objective of this section is to analyze the extent to which the different registration strategies preserve the anatomy of the input image in the synthesized outputs.
To highlight these differences, we introduce a new anatomy-oriented similarity metric. The metric is derived from feature representations extracted by the pretrained TS CT 3 mm segmentation model (M297) used within IMPACT-Reg. The feature extractor remains fixed during evaluation. The underlying intuition is that a similarity metric capable of accurately assessing multimodal anatomical correspondence in image registration should also provide a relevant measure of anatomical consistency between the input image and the synthesized image.
blocks.zh:
本节的目的是分析不同注册策略在多大程度上保留了综合输出中输入图像的解剖.
为了突出这些差异,我们引入了一个新的面向解剖学的类似度量. 该度量标准来自在IMPACT-Reg中使用的预先训练的TS CT 3毫米分片模型(M297)提取的特征表示. 特征提取器在评价期间保持不变。 基本的直觉是,在图像登记中能够准确评估多模式解剖通信的类似性衡量标准也应提供输入图像与合成图像之间解剖一致性的相关衡量标准。

blocks.en: Anatomical consistency results reported in Table VII show substantial differences in the deformation required to align the synthesized images with the input CBCT, as measured with the IMPACT-Reg metric M297. Smaller deformations, i.e., higher anatomical consistency, are consistently obtained for IMPACT-trained models across all evaluated regions.
blocks.zh: 表七中报告的解剖一致性结果显示,按照IMPACT-Reg计量M297的测量结果,将合成图像与输入的CBCT对齐所需的变形有很大差异。 在所有受评价区域,受IMPACT培训的模型都不断获得较小的变形,即较高的解剖一致性。

blocks.en: In in-distribution regions, the relative difference between ELX and IMPACT reaches 124.25% in the abdominal region and 136.65% in head-and-neck cases (both p < 0.001 p<0.001 ), indicating substantially larger deformations, and thus lower anatomical consistency, for ELX-trained models. In the thoracic region, the difference remains statistically significant but is markedly smaller (3.59%, p < 0.01 p<0.01 ). Aggregated across AB/HN/TH regions, ELX-trained models exhibit an overall relative difference of 81.82% compared to IMPACT-trained models ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
blocks.zh: 在分布中地区,ELX与IMPACT的相对差异在腹部区域达到124.25%,头部和颈部病例达到136.65%(均为 < 0.001 p < 0.001),表明对ELX训练过的模型的变形性大得多,从而降低了解剖一致性。 在thoracic地区,这一差异在统计学上仍然显著,但明显较小(3.59%,p < 0.01 p < 0.01)。 在AB/HN/TH区域,ELX训练模型与IMPACT训练模型(p < 0.001 p < 0.001)相比,总的相对差异为81.82%。

blocks.en: A similar trend is observed on Sim-CBCT, where ELX-trained models still require significantly larger deformations than IMPACT-trained models, with a relative difference of 9.65% ( p < 0.001 p<0.001 ).
blocks.zh: 在Sim-CBCT中也观察到类似的趋势,ELX训练过的模型仍然需要比IMPACT训练过的模型大得多的变形,相对差异为9.65%(p < 0.001 p < 0.001)。

blocks.en: Together, these results show that IMPACT-trained models better preserve the anatomy of the input CBCT in both real and simulated CBCT settings.
blocks.zh: 这些结果共同表明,IMFACT训练有素的模型在真实和模拟的CBCT环境中更好地保存输入CBCT的解剖.

Results are reported across anatomical regions for models trained with the SAM criterion. Statistical significance is assessed using paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests on matched patients.

blocks.en: IV-D Official SynthRAD results as a benchmark-bias case study
blocks.zh: 四-D 官方综合RAD结果作为基准-比斯案例研究

blocks.en: The official SynthRAD evaluation provides an external case study of registration-dependent benchmark behavior. In the local experiments, IMPACT-aligned supervision is associated with higher measured anatomical consistency and better performance in several registration-independent or better-aligned settings. In contrast, the official server favors ELX-trained models, whose targets are more consistent with the registration convention used to construct the challenge evaluation references.
blocks.zh: 官方SynthRAD评价提供了对注册依赖基准行为的外部案例研究. 在当地的实验中,IMPACT对齐的监管与在若干独立登记或比较一致的环境下测量到的更高解剖一致性和更好的性能有关. 相比之下,官方服务器倾向于ELX训练模式,其目标更符合用于构建质疑评价参考文献的登记惯例.

blocks.en: Table VIII illustrates this reversal. Under the official protocol, ELX training improves all reported metrics relative to IMPACT training in both tasks. For example, MAE decreases from 75.82 to 68.20 HU in Task 1 and from 56.05 to 52.87 HU in Task 2. These results do not contradict the local anatomical analyses; rather, they show that reference-based scores reflect both synthesis quality and compatibility with the geometry embedded in the evaluation data.
blocks.zh: 表八说明了这一逆转。 根据正式协议,ELX培训在两项任务中改进了所报告的与IMPACT培训有关的所有衡量标准。 例如,在任务1中,MAE从75.82降至68.20HU,在任务2中,MAE从56.05降至52.87HU。 这些结果与局部解剖分析并不矛盾;相反,它们表明,基于参考的分数既反映了合成质量,也反映了与评价数据中嵌入的几何学的兼容性.

blocks.en: TABLE VIII: ELX- versus IMPACT-trained models on the public SynthRAD2025 validation set, as scored by the challenge server. Higher ELX scores reflect agreement with the ELX-consistent evaluation geometry, not established source-anatomy preservation.
blocks.zh: Table VIII: ELX - 在公共SynthRAD2025验证集上对IMFACT训练的模型,由挑战服务器评分. 更高的ELX分数反映了与ELX一致的评价几何学的一致,而不是既定的源解剖学保存.

blocks.en:
The final challenge submission therefore used the five-fold ELX ensemble trained with SAM-based perceptual supervision. This
configuration was selected because the public validation results favored ELX-consistent training, while SAM supervision improved
downstream Dice and qualitative structural preservation despite a moderate increase in local voxel-wise MAE. Checkpoints within each configuration remained selected exclusively according to validation MAE. For the final submission only, the global model was further fine-tuned into two region-specific sub-models (AB+TH and HN); all other results in this paper use the global models.
blocks.zh:
因此,最后的质疑呈件采用了经过基于SAM的感知监督培训的五倍ELX组合。 这个
选择配置是因为公众验证结果有利于ELX一致培训,而SAM监督则有所改善
下游 尽管局部葡萄酒-顺式MAE有适度增加,但食用和定性结构保存. 每个配置中的检查站仍然完全按照审定的MAE选择。 仅就最后提交而言,全球模型被进一步微调为两个针对特定区域的子模型(AB+TH和HN);本文的所有其他结果都使用全球模型.

blocks.en: The submitted method ranked third overall for both MR → \rightarrow CT and CBCT → \rightarrow CT synthesis. It achieved MAEs of 67.24 and 53.09 HU, Dice scores of 0.737 and 0.843, and HD95 values of 7.51 and 5.08 mm, respectively. Dosimetric performance was also competitive, including high gamma pass rates. Complete image-based and dosimetric rankings are provided in Appendix A-D .
blocks.zh: 提交的方法在MR → 右倾CT和CBCT → 右倾CT合成中总体排名第三. 它实现了67.24和53.09HU的MAEs,Dice分数分别为0.737和0.843,HD95值分别为7.51和5.08毫米. 剂量测定性能也具有竞争力,包括高伽玛通过率。 附录A-D提供了完整的图像和剂量排名。

blocks.en: Together, the public validation reversal and the official test results show that the proposed models are competitive under the prescribed challenge protocol while highlighting a limitation of reference-based ranking. The fact that ELX is favored by the ELX-consistent server, whereas IMPACT is favored by several source-preservation and OOD analyses, demonstrates that the evaluation convention can influence the apparent ordering of synthesis strategies.
blocks.zh: 公共验证逆转和官方测试结果共同显示,在规定的质疑协议下,提议的模型具有竞争力,同时突出了基于参考的排名限制. ELX受到与ELX一致的服务器的青睐,而IMPACT则受到一些源保护和OD分析的青睐,这表明评价公约可以影响合成战略的明显顺序。

blocks.en: IV-E Estimation of registration-induced sensitivity in sCT evaluation metrics
blocks.zh: 四-E 对SCT评价指标中登记引起的敏感性的估计

blocks.en: These experiments estimate the magnitude of evaluation error that can arise from residual multimodal misregistration alone, without any synthesis process. Rather than defining a theoretical performance bound, the resulting values provide an empirical registration-induced reference level for MAE, PSNR, SSIM, d SAM d_{\mathrm{SAM}} , LPIPS, and Dice.
blocks.zh: 这些实验估计了仅由遗留的多式联运错误登记就可能产生评价错误的程度,而没有任何综合过程。 所产生的数值不是定义理论性能约束,而是为MAE、PSNR、SSIM、dSAM d_{\mathrm{SAM}}、LPIPS和Dice提供了经验性登记引起的参考水平。

blocks.en: To isolate this effect from any synthesis error, all controls were constructed from CT images only. The goal was to ask how much the evaluation metrics can change when the CT reference geometry is modified by registration, even though no synthetic CT is generated. The control was adapted to the evaluation geometry available in each benchmark. In SynthRAD2023 brain and pelvis cases, where the official CT reference is only rigidly aligned to the MR image, we compared this rigid CT with an IMPACT-deformed CT to estimate the effect of adding a plausible non-rigid correspondence. In SynthRAD2025 AB, HN, and TH cases, where deformable registration is already used, we applied a cycle-deformation control: the CT was first transformed according to the ELX deformation and then mapped back using the IMPACT deformation field. This estimates the metric sensitivity to switching between two plausible non-rigid registration conventions, without introducing any synthesis model.
blocks.zh: 为了将这种效果从任何合成错误中分离出来,所有控制都只从CT图像中构建出来. 目的是询问在通过注册修改CT参考几何时,即使没有生成合成CT,评价的衡量标准可以改变多少. 根据每个基准中可用的评价几何方法调整了控制。 在SynthRAD2023脑和骨盆病例中,官方的CT参考只与MR图像刚性对齐,我们用一个IMPACT变形的CT来比较这个刚性CT,以估计添加一个可信的非刚性通信的效果. 在SynthRAD2025 AB,HN,以及TH等已经使用变形注册的案例中,我们应用了一个循环变形控制:CT首先按照ELX变形转换,然后使用IMPACT变形场进行回图. 这估计了在不采用任何综合模型的情况下,在两种可能的非严格登记公约之间转换的衡量敏感性。

blocks.en: This analysis uses the disagreement between ELX and IMPACT as a proxy for registration-dependent geometric uncertainty. The preceding segmentation analysis indicates higher average anatomical consistency for IMPACT, but neither method is treated as ground truth. Agreement between their deformation fields suggests a relatively well-constrained correspondence, whereas disagreement identifies regions in which the estimated anatomy and the resulting evaluation metrics are more sensitive to the registration convention.
blocks.zh: 这一分析利用ELX和IMPACT之间的分歧作为依赖注册的几何不确定性的代名词. 前面的分解分析表明,IMPACT的平均解剖一致性较高,但这两种方法都不被视为地面真理。 变形区之间的协议表明,它们之间的通信比较紧张,而分歧则表明,在哪些地区,估计解剖学和由此产生的评价指标对登记公约更为敏感。

blocks.en: Table IX compares these CT-derived controls with representative supervised sCT results. In the SynthRAD2025 AB/HN/TH regions, registration alone produces aggregated MAEs of 60.02 HU for Task 1 and 53.42 HU for Task 2, with corresponding SSIM values of 0.927 and 0.938. In the SynthRAD2023 brain/pelvis regions, the estimated MAEs are 59.18 HU and 39.50 HU for Tasks 1 and 2, respectively. These values are of the same order of magnitude as those obtained by high-performing supervised synthesis methods, despite the absence of synthesis error in the CT-derived controls.

For the aggregate comparisons, the supervised MAE, PSNR, and SSIM/MS-SSIM values correspond to the best official SynthRAD2023 and
SynthRAD2025 submissions. Regional image-similarity values for AB, HN, and TH are obtained from the best local validation results of the region-specific fine-tuned ELX/SAM models submitted to the challenge [ 37 ] . blocks.en: Several supervised results match or even outperform the CT-derived controls on MAE, PSNR, or SSIM, but this does not invalidate the sensitivity estimate. A synthesis model optimized against an imperfect reference can reduce voxel-wise penalties through local smoothing, attenuation of high-gradient boundaries, or adaptation to the evaluation geometry, whereas the CT-derived controls retain sharp CT structures. Consistent with this interpretation, the controls generally preserve substantially higher Dice scores, and their perceptual values are often closer to those of SAM-trained models than to purely MAE-trained models.
blocks.zh: 若干监督结果与MAE、PSNR或SSIM的CT衍生控制相匹配,甚至超过了控制,但这并不使敏感度估计失效。 对照不完善的参考进行优化的合成模型,可以通过局部的平滑,高阶边界的减弱,或适应评价几何,从而减少对阴极的判罚,而CT衍生的控制则保留尖锐的CT结构. 与这种解释一致,控制通常保留了高得多的Dice分数,其感知值往往更接近于SAM训练模型,而不是纯粹的MAE训练模型.

blocks.en: These estimates should be conservatively interpreted. The cycle experiment captures only the disagreement between two regularized and anatomically plausible registration methods, while the SynthRAD2023 deformations were intentionally constrained, particularly for brain cases. Additional perturbation experiments also showed that MAE increases rapidly with small changes to the deformation fields. Therefore, the controls likely underestimate the full effect of correspondence uncertainty.
blocks.zh: 这些估计应作保守的解释。 循环实验只捕捉两种正规化和解剖上合理的登记方法之间的分歧,而SynthRAD2023变形则被故意限制,特别是针对大脑病例. 额外的扰动实验也表明,MAE随着变形场的微小变化而迅速增加. 因此,控制可能低估了函证不确定性的全部影响。

blocks.en: Overall, high-performing supervised sCT methods operate within the same metric range as that induced by residual registration uncertainty alone. This suggests that current reference-based benchmarks may be approaching a registration-dependent performance ceiling, where small improvements partly reflect better adaptation to the evaluation geometry rather than improved patient-specific anatomical fidelity.
blocks.zh: 总体而言,高性能的受监督SCT方法的运作范围与仅由剩余登记不确定性引起的方法相同。 这表明,目前的参照基准可能正在接近一个依赖登记的业绩上限,其中小幅改进部分反映了对评价几何的更好适应,而不是针对病人的解剖忠心。

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en:
The results reported above support a coherent interpretation centered on the interaction between registration quality, voxel-wise supervision, and the metrics used to assess synthesis performance.
This view directly builds on the concept of registration-induced target uncertainty introduced in Section II-A , where residual registration errors were described as structured geometric label noise shaping the empirical conditional distribution p ⁡ ( y ~ ∣ x ) p(\tilde{y}\mid x) learned by supervised synthesis models.
blocks.zh:
以上报告的结果支持以登记质量、视毒监督与用于评估综合性能的衡量标准之间的相互作用为核心的一致解释。
这种观点直接基于第二-A节中引入的登记引起的目标不确定性的概念,该节将剩余登记错误描述为结构化的几何标签噪声,塑造了监督合成模型所学习到的经验性有条件分布p ⁡ (y ~ ∣ x) p (\tilde{ y}\ mid x).

blocks.en: V-A Registration bias as structured label noise
blocks.zh: V-A 作为结构化标签噪声的登记偏差

blocks.en: The central finding of this study is that reference-based synthesis performance depends not only on the synthesis model, but also on the compatibility between the registration conventions used to construct the training targets and evaluation references. Residual registration errors therefore act as structured geometric label noise at two levels: they shape the target distribution learned during training and influence the reference against which predictions are subsequently scored [ 10 ] .
blocks.zh: 这项研究的主要结论是,基于参考的合成性能不仅取决于综合模型,而且还取决于用于构建培训目标和评价参考的登记公约之间的兼容性。 因此,残余的注册错误在两个层次上作为结构化的几何标签噪声:它们塑造了在培训期间学到的目标分布,并影响随后预测得分的参照[10].

blocks.en: The matched and mismatched experiments provide direct evidence for this effect. As summarized in Table II , evaluating IMPACT-trained models against ELX rather than IMPACT references increases aggregate MAE from 63.55 to 72.47 HU in Task 1 and from 58.76 to 69.17 HU in Task 2. ELX-trained models similarly perform better under the ELX convention in both tasks. Because the predictions remain unchanged while only the evaluation reference is replaced, these differences show that voxel-wise scores measure both synthesis fidelity and agreement with the selected registration geometry.
blocks.zh: 匹配和不匹配的实验为这种效应提供了直接的证据。 如表二所概述,对照ELX而不是IMPACT的参考,评价IMFACT训练模型,使任务1中的MAE总量从63.55增加到72.47,任务2中的MAE从58.76增加到69.17。 ELX训练有素的模型在ELX公约下在这两项任务中同样表现较好. 由于预测保持不变,而只取代了评价参考文献,这些差异表明,voxel-wise的分数既衡量综合忠诚度,也衡量与选定注册几何的一致度.

blocks.en:
Registration inconsistency also affects what the model learns. The qualitative example in Figure 2 shows blurred and displaced interfaces around the diaphragm in the
ELX-trained prediction. As described in Section II-A , spatially variable targets broaden
the observed distribution p ⁡ ( y ~ ∣ x ) p(\tilde{y}\mid x) . Under voxel-wise ℓ 1 \ell_{1} optimization, predicting a smoother intermediate boundary can reduce the expected penalty associated with placing a sharp structure at an uncertain location. Thus, although architectures with spatial skip connections possess a strong inductive bias toward preserving spatial organization, the optimization objective ultimately dominates the learned behavior. Under inconsistent voxel-wise supervision, ERM drives the model toward solutions that minimize the expected reconstruction error, even when this requires smoothing anatomical boundaries, attenuating high-frequency structures, or locally altering patient-specific anatomy.
